label: Security & Trust
seo_description: Tenant isolation, audit-ready exports, regional compliance defaults, and honest attestations—for schools and procurement teams worldwide.
headline: Security your board and auditors can understand.
subheadline: Every campus stays isolated. Access is role-based and logged. We document posture honestly—certifications and live payment rails only when externally verified for your deployment.

segments.title: Campus isolation
segments.body: Each school's data is scoped to its tenant. Cross-campus access is deliberate, permissioned, and reviewable—not accidental.

segments.title: Operational visibility
segments.body: Security controls are tested continuously in our release pipeline. Your team receives summaries suitable for RFPs—not engineering jargon buried in tickets.

segments.title: Support access
segments.body: When operators assist your school, impersonation and elevation are logged. There is no silent back-door access path.

segments.title: Exports & records
segments.body: Sensitive exports require permission checks. Student-record downloads follow the same discipline your registrars expect.

extras.architecture_summary: RunMyCampus is multi-tenant by design: each school operates in its own scoped environment with host-level routing, role-based access, and regional configuration profiles. Groups can govern many campuses without blending student records.
extras.encryption_copy: Data is encrypted in transit (TLS). Sensitive fields at rest use platform key management with documented rotation procedures—details are included in the security packet we provide during procurement.
